column1: # Public portraits for the teeth segmenter (docs/27 S-17): id <TAB> SHA-256 <TAB> URL <TAB> licence, source and what the test expects.
# Fetched by tools/fetch/teeth-photos.sh into testdata/teeth/photos/<id>.jpg; never committed. Every photo is CC0 or flagged public domain by
# its provider (found with Openverse); a file with another hash is refused. The last column says whether SAM is expected to find teeth:
# `teeth` (an open mouth with teeth in the face the finder ranks first), `no-teeth` (a smile with the teeth hidden: nothing is found), `blown-out`
# (a face washed out to white: SAM's masks spill onto the lips and the face gets no whitening).
